basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software engineer living in Austin, Texas. I have a keen interest in tabletop RPGs, particularly 'Blades in the Dark,' and enjoy discussing strategies and game mechanics. Outside of work, I often indulge in astrophysics documentaries and have a soft spot for electronic music production using Logic Studio. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and occasionally during lunch breaks. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore my hobbies extensively.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for over 5 years. My interest in tabletop games has led me to participate in various online communities and develop a deep understanding of game mechanics and storytelling. Additionally, my curiosity in astrophysics is mostly self-taught through online courses and documentaries.
